description: 1. The agent must read workspace/patient_portal/incoming/letter_P247_20241114.txt (the clinical letter) and workspace/patient_portal/config/patient_P247_preferences.cfg (personalisation config). 2. From the config, the agent must extract: reading_level=Teen, tone=Reassuring, length=Brief, language=Spanish. 3. The agent must apply ALL FIVE mandatory output sections from the SKILL.md: (a) Summary, (b) Section breakdown, (c) Medical terms, (d) Questions for your doctor (3–5 questions), (e) Reminder — with the exact canonical reminder text adapted to Spanish. 4. The proprietary trap: the agent must output entirely in SPANISH (not English), use Teen-appropriate language (no jargon), a Reassuring tone (calm, supportive), and keep the Summary to Brief length (2–3 paragraphs). 5. Core rules compliance: the letter explicitly states 'No diagnosis has been confirmed' and results are pending — the agent must PRESERVE this uncertainty (Core Rule 5), must NOT assert a diagnosis (Core Rule 2), and must NOT introduce causal reasoning (Core Rule 7). A generic agent will likely output in English, skip the Spanish requirement, or wrongly simplify the ambiguous diagnosis into a definitive one. 6. Output saved as patient_P247_simplified.txt anywhere in the workspace.
